definition: Operating NWC = AR + inventories + other current assets - prepaid income taxes - identified capital-credit receivables - (AP/accruals - current income taxes - dividends - operating/finance leases - restructuring) - contract liabilities. IC = NWC + net PP&E + goodwill + purchased intangibles. Cash and marketable/strategic investments excluded; R&D capitalized only in separate sensitivity.
limitations: This is a reproducible defined operating-capital proxy, not a claim that every other asset/liability is operating. Noncurrent operating balances and unidentified hedging/compensation amounts remain outside the definition. Possible bond-interest and other financing accruals are also unidentified; this proxy is not a full debt-like-claim reconciliation.

FY2016/2017 revenue and some balances are retrospective ASC606 figures while supplemental current-tax asset detail is from contemporaneous annual notes; avoid interpreting the early-year incremental ratios as exact marginal economics.

Capital incentives reduce PP&E but cash capex and refunds can occur in different periods. Historical cash reinvestment series excludes refund adjustments and is a conservative gross-capex diagnostic, not normalized FCFF.
Zero for undisclosed historical finance/operating lease or restructuring lines is explicitly an immateriality/comparability assumption, not a reported zero.

FY2024 annual Note8 checked: current capital incentives were netted in current taxes payable, which are excluded; FY2025 current grant receivable233 removed separately. FY2023/2024 PP&E grant offsets154/479 and FY2025 offset1200 depress book capital versus gross economics.

rd_accounting: 5-year straight-line is an analyst sensitivity, not management useful life. To preserve tax/cash consistency when current R&D is tax deductible, adjusted NOPAT = reported EBIT*(1-t) + (R&D-amortization), with the same net R&D investment deducted in FCFF. Conventional (adjusted EBIT)*(1-t) ROIC shown only as comparative normalized-tax diagnostic. Do not add research asset to EV or capitalize R&D while also leaving the full R&D expense in operating margin.

fieldDefinitions.debt_current: Raw SEC current portion of long-term debt, not total current debt including commercial paper. See FY2025 debt reconciliation in readiness bundle.
